title: Ordering Coffee
topic: ordering drinks and handling small problems at a cafe
scene: A neighborhood cafe at 8:30 a.m. The line is moving, and the barista is friendly but busy.
goals: 用 I'd like / Can I get 完成点单
说明尺寸、温度、外卖和加料
发现拿错时礼貌地请求重做
和店员做一两句自然闲聊

lecture.overview: 点咖啡是最实用的口语场景之一。先练稳妥句型 I'd like a ..., please. 再补上尺寸、热冷、外带。进阶时学会 customize（燕麦奶、少冰、加一份浓缩），以及拿错时不卑不亢地说明问题。真正的流利，不是背菜单，而是能在噪声和排队里把需求说清楚。

patterns.en: Can I get that for here / to go?
patterns.note: for here = 堂食，to go = 外带

patterns.en: Could you make it with oat milk?
patterns.note: make it with 用来改配料

patterns.en: I think this might be the wrong order.
patterns.note: 比 You made a mistake 更软、更自然

tips: 先报饮品，再报尺寸和特殊要求，店员更好记。
听不清时直接说 Sorry, could you repeat that? 比装懂更省事。
名字报一个短的、好拼的即可，不必解释姓氏。

dialogues.title: 简单点单
dialogues.summary: 只要一杯热美式，带走。句型短，节奏慢。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hi. I'd like a coffee, please.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Sure. Americano or latte?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: An Americano, please. Hot.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Small, medium, or large?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Medium, please.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: For here or to go?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: To go, please.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: That's 4.50. Card is fine.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Here you go. Thanks.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Your drink will be ready in a minute.

dialogues.title: 定制一杯
dialogues.titleEn: Make it the way I like
dialogues.summary: 燕麦奶、少冰、加一份浓缩，还要报名字。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hi. Can I get an iced latte?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Of course. What size?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Large, please. Could you make it with oat milk?
turns.zh: 大杯。可以换成燕麦奶吗？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Oat milk is fine. Anything else?
turns.zh: 燕麦奶没问题。还要别的吗？

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: An extra shot, and not too much ice.
turns.zh: 加一份浓缩，冰不要太多。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Got it. One large iced oat latte, extra shot, light ice.
turns.zh: 收到。大杯冰燕麦拿铁，加一份浓缩，少冰。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Yes, that's perfect.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Name for the order?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Alex. Just A-L-E-X.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Great. I'll call you when it's ready.

dialogues.title: 拿错了
dialogues.summary: 拿到的是热的、还偏甜。练习礼貌地指出问题。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Sorry, I think this might be the wrong order.
turns.zh: 不好意思，这好像不是我点的。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Oh? What did you order?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: An iced oat latte, not too sweet.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: This one is hot, and it has vanilla syrup.
turns.zh: 这杯是热的，还加了香草糖浆。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Yeah. Could you remake it? No syrup, please.
turns.zh: 对。能重做一杯吗？不要糖浆。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Absolutely. Sorry about that. I'll do it right away.
turns.zh: 当然可以，抱歉。我马上做。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: No worries. I'm not in a rush.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Thanks for being patient. I'll make it extra cold.
turns.zh: 谢谢你的耐心。我会做得更冰一点。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: That would be great.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Here you go. Iced oat latte, no syrup. Enjoy.
turns.zh: 给你。冰燕麦拿铁，无糖浆。请慢用。

dialogues.title: 和店员闲聊
dialogues.summary: 点完单后问推荐、Wi-Fi 和积分卡，像常客一样说话。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Morning. What's good if I need to stay awake?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Honestly? The cold brew is stronger than it looks.
turns.zh: 说实话？冷萃看起来温和，实际很猛。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: I'll take that. And is the Wi-Fi decent today?
turns.zh: 那我要这个。今天 Wi-Fi 还行吗？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: It's fine if you sit by the window. Password is on the board.
turns.zh: 坐窗边就还行。密码写在板上。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Perfect. Do you have a loyalty card?
turns.zh: 太好了。你们有积分卡吗？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: We do. Buy nine drinks, the tenth is on us.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Nice. I've been coming here more often lately.
turns.zh: 不错。我最近来得更勤了。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: I noticed. You usually get the oat latte, right?
turns.zh: 我注意到了。你平时是燕麦拿铁吧？

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Usually, yes. Today I need something stronger.
turns.zh: 平时是。今天需要更提神的。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Then this should do the trick. I'll bring it over.
turns.zh: 那这杯应该管用。我给你送过去。

vocab.note: 点单首选，比 I want 更礼貌
美式口语；英式常说 takeaway
菜单上最常见的黑咖啡说法

vocab.example: Can I get an iced latte?
vocab.note: 比 I'd like 更随意、更口语

vocab.example: Could you make it with oat milk?
vocab.note: 植物奶里最常点的一种

vocab.example: An extra shot, and not too much ice.
One large iced oat latte, extra shot, light ice.
vocab.note: 店员复述时常用这个短写法

vocab.example: I think this might be the wrong order.
vocab.note: 投诉时先说问题，不先怪人

vocab.example: Could you remake it? No syrup, please.
vocab.note: 饮料做错了就用 remake，不要说 redo the coffee

vocab.example: No worries. I'm not in a rush.
The cold brew is stronger than it looks.
vocab.note: 提神场景里很自然的推荐

vocab.example: Do you have a loyalty card?
Buy nine drinks, the tenth is on us.
vocab.note: on the house 是近义说法

vocab.example: Then this should do the trick.
vocab.note: 口语里表示「这应该就够了」
